package.description: Command Code subscription reverse proxy with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

en-US.description: Command Code subscription reverse proxy with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
en-US.longDescription: CommandCodeGo Manager is a desktop app that reverse-proxies a Command Code subscription into OpenAI-compatible (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses) and Anthropic-compatible (/v1/messages) endpoints for any harness or SDK. It includes a Chinese web administration interface with a dashboard, live request logs, usage statistics, model lists, key management, device fingerprint inspection, and settings. The service keeps running in the background with a tray icon after the window closes.
en-US.name: CommandCodeGo Manager

zh-CN.description: Command Code 订阅反向代理，提供 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容端点。
zh-CN.longDescription: CommandCodeGo Manager 是一款桌面应用，把 Command Code 订阅额度反代为 OpenAI 兼容（/v1/chat/completions、/v1/responses）与 Anthropic 兼容（/v1/messages）端点，供任意 harness 和 SDK 使用。自带中文 Web 管理界面（仪表盘、实时日志、用量统计、模型列表、密钥管理、设备指纹、设置）。关闭窗口后服务在后台继续运行（托盘常驻）。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
fix(rotation): 额度耗尽自动轮转三处失灵(#12)
- 固定/绑定不再越过账户状态：「切到此账号」与密钥绑定原先不检查 status,锁定一个已耗尽/已停用的账户后永远不会再换号。现在固定与绑定都只是偏好，不可用时按同一套可用性规则兜底。
- 429 额度语义认得出：真身 RATE_LIMITED + 「weekly usage limit … limit resets at 」文本原先认不出(只认 USAGE_EXCEEDED/rateLimit.window)。现在额度码或额度措辞都认，重置时间优先取 rateLimit.reset,其次取报文里的 ISO 时间；瞬态 429 与请求类错误(Bad Request / 模型不可用 / 地区限制)仍不轮转。
- 额度耗尽回 200 也认：上游把「no credits remaining」塞进 200 的 SSE 体里时，转发前窥探响应首段(≤16KB / ≤3s,见到正文事件立即放行),命中错误事件按额度耗尽处理并当笔轮转重试。
- 月度信用归零：用量刷新发现 totalRemaining === 0 时标记到当期结束(补额度自动解除),不再每笔请求都打到一个必然失败的账户上。
fix(rotation): thinking 流首字节延迟
窥探正则 CONTENT_STARTED 漏了本协议的 reasoning-start/reasoning-delta,推理先行的流会被扣满 3s 预算才放行；已补上(含 tool-call 兜底)并加回归用例。
New Contributors
- @bixianzuose made their first contribution in https://github.com/learningdog1/CommandCodeGo-manager/pull/12
Full Changelog: https://github.com/learningdog1/CommandCodeGo-manager/compare/v0.2.15...v0.2.16
